title: COMSTECH Fellowships for Research and Trainings in Human Nutrition, Nutraceuticals and Food Sciences
official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
duration: 3 to 6 months, extendable upon recommendation from the host institution
description: COMSTECH and prestigious CCoE member institutions jointly offer research fellowships to young researchers in OIC countries for short- to medium-term research placements (3 to 6 months) in advanced institutions, aiming to build technical capacity in agriculture, food security and related areas and empower early-career professionals.

title: COMSTECH Fellowships for Research and Advanced Training in Virology and Vaccine Technologies
official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
description: COMSTECH, in collaboration with key centres of excellence in OIC countries, offers fellowships enabling young scientists to spend three months at a relevant centre of excellence to build research and development capacity in virology and vaccine technology and meet the challenge of current and future pandemics.

title: COMSTECH Research Fellowships for Women Scientists in Least Developed Countries (LDCs) in the OIC
official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
duration: 6 to 12 months, extendable upon recommendation of the host institution
description: COMSTECH and prestigious CCoE member institutions jointly offer research fellowships to young women researchers, scientists and engineers in OIC countries, enabling them to spend 6-12 months at a relevant centre of excellence to enhance research and development capacity and foster long-term collaboration.

title: EAC Scholarship Programme (EACSP) - Two-Year Funded Master's Scholarships, Cohort 4 (Phase II)
official_source: Inter-University Council for East Africa (IUCEA), implementing the East African Community and Federal Republic of Germany initiative
description: The EAC Scholarship Programme is a regional initiative of the East African Community and the Federal Republic of Germany, implemented by IUCEA, developing future leaders who contribute to regional integration and sustainable development by supporting Master's studies in an EAC Partner State other than the scholar's country of citizenship.

title: COMSTECH Research Fellowships for Least Developed Countries (LDCs) in the OIC
official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
duration: 6 to 12 months, extendable upon recommendation of the host institution
description: COMSTECH and prestigious CCoE member institutions jointly offer research fellowships to young researchers in OIC countries so they can spend 6-12 months at a relevant centre of excellence, enhancing the research and development capacity of promising researchers and engineers - especially those from least developed countries - and helping them foster linkages for further collaboration in their fields.

title: Petroleum Technology Development Fund (PTDF) In-Country Scholarship Scheme (ISS) 2026/27
funding: Scholarship (coverage not itemised in the published guidelines)
official_source: Petroleum Technology Development Fund (PTDF), a Federal Government of Nigeria agency
duration: Not published as a fixed award term; the scheme covers Undergraduate, Master's and PhD awards within Nigerian public universities, with undergraduate eligibility anchored to study at 200 level
description: The Petroleum Technology Development Fund is a Nigerian federal government agency mandated with developing indigenous human capacity and petroleum technology for the oil and gas industry. The Fund invites applications from qualified Nigerians for its 2026/27 Undergraduate, Master's and PhD scholarships, restricted to Nigerian public universities and to a published list of sponsored courses grouped into engineering, science, environmental science, renewable energy and management. title: Kingdom of Morocco – Government of Rwanda Scholarships (2026/2027)
official_source: Kingdom of Morocco, scholarship call published by the Higher Education Council (HEC) of Rwanda
description: A bilateral scholarship scheme in which the Kingdom of Morocco awards places to Rwandan nationals to study at Moroccan public training institutions and universities, taught in French. The 2026/2027 call covers diploma, bachelor's, master's and PhD levels. Applications are handled by Rwanda's Higher Education Council through its HEC MIS online system rather than directly by the candidate. The published 2026/2027 application deadline was 29 August 2026, so this cycle has closed and the next call is expected in the same late-August window.
